test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'RADIO' is written as 'SZEHP' and 'FREQUENCY' is written as 'GQFPVDOBZ'. How will 'TELEVISION' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'RADIO' is written as 'SZEHP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/246be378c22a48e7b05bab34bdfcbe88d5110b9ef4acd02fa411e3240a6e98f5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15e9feaed42933a250ca46443c772c17a54abb11d69ef256f31fc0ba4606e1b8.png] 

'FREQUENCY' is written as 'GQFPVDOBZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a59a4c468a895422e8ee60626ab16471f9ab9a0c5cf94dadeeb134641e79ca37.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0bd7a2e8bab4bf66ca082b95d6a500406ef74061632ecaf18374d203c7ba660.png] 

Similarly, 'TELEVISION' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebb11ca503650e6983ba8955c7a5995e9a2c88b08800d699f22ea189b223b1fd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38eece28f42e736c267bf44f536d528efecf7ad74d39dad15df9a2d11bfd9185.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"UDMDWHTHPM".**
